SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Word Classes: ➢ Adverbs ➢ Use of could, would and how many ➢ How many...could/wo uld, part of Strand 9 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade five General.

Key inquiry question: How do we describe when, how, where and how many times an action takes place? 2. Which word or words do we use to ask questions?
